stem: A tea garden in Darjeeling had 1,200 visitors this year. A model predicts that the number of visitors per year will double every 3 years. According to the model, how many visitors will the tea garden have in the year that is 9 years from now?
solution: In 9 years there are \(\frac{9}{3} = 3\) doubling periods.
verify:
t = 9
n = 1200 * 2**Rational(t, 3)
assert n == 9600
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [n]
